crossRefs.note: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,
Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net…
Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the…
When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying; that is Peter, John, James, Andrew…

people.name: John
people.line: The Baptist, a prophet who prepared the way for Jesus

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
translations.bsb: Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, was one of the two who heard John’s testimony and followed Jesus.
translations.kjv: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.
translations.asv: One of the two that heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.
